name: radiant_guard
description: a Radiant Guard (Fall from Heaven), a holy knight in polished silver plate armour with gold trim: a closed silver great helm with a gold-trimmed T-shaped visor crowned by a golden sunburst crest, gold-rimmed pauldrons, a blue tabard with a golden sun emblem, a brown belt, a white cape hanging behind him on the screen-left, steel greaves and gold-trimmed sabatons, and a short halberd in his LEFT hand: a brown wooden shaft with a golden sun finial and two crescent steel axe blades
hands: the halberd stays in his left hand on the screen-right side, gripped round the shaft at waist height with the axe head up; his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty gauntleted fist at his side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the halberd is lifted up over the head with its axe head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the halberd cocked behind the head with the axe head hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the halberd is level, its axe head pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: halberd arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the steel axe blade chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the halberd carries on down until its axe head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the white cape trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the halberd lifts back toward its upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the helmed head snaps back toward the upper-left, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty gauntleted right fist flung out to the left, the halberd arm thrown up and out), the white cape swinging
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the halberd dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, halberd arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the helmed head droops, the halberd lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the halberd's axe head resting on the ground, the right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the halberd slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the white cape flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the golden sunburst crest on the ground; the halberd lies on the ground at the lower-right; the white cape spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the white cape settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the visor dark, the halberd on the ground beside him
